Authentic chunky low-resolution pixel art, readable square pixel clusters, simplified realistic metal and polymer, restrained muted industrial colors, upper-left light and clear lighter edges on dark green UI. Consistent slightly elevated three-quarter product display, entire single object visible, centered within 40x40 logical pixels on 48x48 canvas with at least 4 logical pixels transparent padding. Genuinely transparent background, no ground, shadow, scene, firearm, hands, person, UI, rarity background, text, logos, letters, numbers, glow, watermark, photorealism or futuristic elements. Object ONLY: broad straight pistol caliber magazine, dark blued steel body, wide feed lips and large brass cartridge, short standard capacity body with distinctive cloth pull tab on base.

assets.name: .45 ACP 快速扩容弹匣
assets.prompt: 为像素游戏《潮汐线》绘制一件静态、未安装的枪械配件物品图标：.45 ACP 快速扩容弹匣。蓝黑色宽直钢制弹匣，较宽的供弹口，侧面观察孔。加长扩容主体，底部有橡胶快拔拉环。弹匣必须竖直摆放，供弹口朝上，底板朝下，不要横放或斜躺。采用固定三分之四前视角，轻微俯视：物体前侧位于画面左侧前景，后侧退向右侧后景；能看见前端立面、右侧面和少量顶部。轻微近大远小，不要强广角，不镜像或左右翻转。低饱和复古工业像素风，材质清晰，左上光源。没有人物，没有完整枪械，没有战斗场景。单个完整物品，透明背景，中央构图，适合48×48像素图标，周围留4px透明安全边。无文字、无标志、无场景、无投影、无光效。
